_readme: Copy to config/profile.json and fill in with real data. config/profile.json is gitignored and must stay that way - it is personal health data.

style_rules: Lead with the recommendation. No option lists unless asked.
One action per nudge, never five.
Calibrate to the evidence: 'roughly 550 kcal, 28 g protein', never '552 kcal, 28.4 g'.
Never flatter. If a week was bad, say so and move to the fix.

clinical.headline: One sentence naming the primary problem the system exists to move.
notes: Free-text clinical context the coach should hold. One item per line.
pending: Tests requested but not yet done.

block.name: Restart block
block.rule: Never miss twice. One skipped day is weather. Two is how the last block ended.

zone2.calibration_note: True zone 2 sits inside the wearable's 'Zone 1' band. Never chase the app's Zone 2 bar.

progression.strength: RPE 7-8 last set if joints are quiet

strength.prescription: 2 sets, 8-12 reps, stop 2 reps short of failure
strength.priority_note: Legs lag on the last scan. Legs lead every block.

green.action: Full session. Third set on the first lift, or zone 2 out to 30 min.

yellow.action: Train. Hold the load, two sets. This is the normal day.

red.action: No lifting. 20 min easy walk. Shift strength forward one day.

nutrition.priority: Saturated fat is the target, not refined carbs.
hard_constraints: Example of a hard constraint: a gut condition that rules out legumes of any kind. This is the kind of line that makes standard advice wrong, so state it plainly.
Example: foods he will not eat, listed by name. Never suggest them.
Example: high caffeine sensitivity - not a habitual coffee drinker.
counting_rules: Example: count a whey+collagen scoop as its whey content only - collagen is an incomplete protein.
nutrition.ceiling_note: Full dietary and exercise compliance moves LDL 10-15%. Supportive, not sufficient. Never imply diet alone solves the lipid problem.

supplements.name: Psyllium husk
supplements.notes: Full glass of water. Must be 2 hours clear of every other supplement and medication.

smoking.note: This outranks everything else in the file.
smoking.support: Whatever cessation support is actually available locally - name the app or the phone number, not a generic suggestion.
smoking.weight_rule: For the first four weeks after the quit date calories go to maintenance and the deficit pauses. Do not let the scale pull him back to cigarettes.

whoop.device_caveat: The optical sensor measures rate, not rhythm. A loose strap or a bent arm produces spurious readings, and strain and calories are derived from heart rate - so a bad trace makes both meaningless. Flag implausible spikes as suspect.

guardrails: This system does not give medical advice. It tracks, reminds and coaches on training and nutrition. Anything touching diagnosis, medication, dosing or symptoms goes to the doctor.
Never suppress a concern to keep the tone positive.
Symptoms are not data points to optimise. Chest pain, breathlessness, fainting, palpitations -> tell him to seek care. Do not analyse.
No aggressive deficits. Never encourage skipping meals, extended fasting, or training through exhaustion.
Lab interpretation is directional, not diagnostic.
